Alex - thanks, happy to join a tech call. Below is a concise integration checklist and answers to your questions.

Integration checklist (high level):
- SDK setup: pip/npm install redwood-sdk; initialize client with API key or workload-specific service token.
- Auth: for sandbox we'll provide a scoped API key with rerank:read/write. For production use we recommend short-lived service tokens + KMS for secret rotation.
- Routing: send retrieval candidates to /v1/rerank with payload {query, candidates: [id, text, embedding?], top_k}. The server supports both text-only and embedding-aware reranking.
- Structured output/tool calling: use the "structured":true flag if you want JSON annotations or tool-call outputs (e.g., extract snippet offsets).
- Embeddings: you can either supply pre-computed embeddings for candidates or let our engine compute them. For large candidate pools we recommend pre-computing embeddings and sending them to speed up scoring.

Default params & tuning: 
- top_k: default 10; tune based on UX. For a support UI we often see Precision@1 prioritized; start with top_k=5 for evaluation then sweep 1-20.
- candidate_pool_size: 50-200 is common. For very large pools use retrieval+BM25 to surface ~100 candidates then rerank.
- batching: batch up to 64 queries or candidates depending on GPU size to improve throughput.

Evaluation guidance:
- Metrics: Precision@1/3/5, MRR@10, and NDCG@10 are standard. Also report latency (ms/token or ms/request) and cost/token for comparison.
- A/B: run reranker A/B on a held-out set to measure regression vs baseline retrieval.
- Labeling: if you have click logs, use position bias correction (IPW); otherwise create a human-labeled sample (1k queries).

Questions for you: 
1) Will you provide pre-computed embeddings for candidates or want us to compute?
2) Do you need the reranker to return structured tool-call outputs (e.g., highlighted excerpt, citation id)?
3) Any throughput SLA (p95 latency) we should tune for during the eval?

Code snippet (Python):
from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="<SANDBOX_KEY>")
resp = client.rerank.reorder(
    query="How do I reset my password?",
    candidates=[{"id":"123","text":"Steps to reset password..."}, {...}],
    top_k=5,
    structured=True
)
print(resp['ranked'])

I'll attach the short "reranker-integration-guide.md" with expanded examples and the endpoint shapes. Happy to schedule a 30-min walk-through; propose Tue/Thu next week.
